objective: Preallocate EXPLAIN join predicate member vectors from known HashSet sizes before sorting.

tasks.title: Preallocate EXPLAIN predicate members
tasks.result: EXPLAIN join-order predicate member lists now preallocate from the known HashSet size before sorting.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was full.
The change preserves predicate column extraction, schema matching, unknown-column fallback, sorted member order, and EXPLAIN join-order selection semantics.
